sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent form. Sandbach are in outstanding shape, unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W) and sitting top with 22 points from 10 games, while Alsager Town are bottom of the table with just 4 points and have lost their last five consecutive fixtures, making this a heavily one-sided encounter on paper.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town at 15:00 in a potentially tight mid-table contest, with Stafford on a mixed run (D-W-W-L-W-D) while Dawley show recent improvement (W-D-L-W-W-L). Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a direct top-four battle, with AFC Bridgnorth recovering from a loss with recent wins while Eccleshall come in after defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community, another mid-table clash where the Casuals are on an upswing. Bilston Town travel to face Foley Meir in a lower-mid-table encounter. In-form Barnton host Shawbury United despite the home team's mixed recent record, while Shawbury are struggling badly with five consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills, both teams searching for consistency. Crewe face a tough away trip to Allscott Heath, with Crewe's poor form (L-L-W-W-L-L) continuing to concern. Finally, struggling Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a basement-level clash where both sides have been drawing more than winning recently, with Widnes Town hosting Brereton Social in another battle between sides in or near the relegation zone.
